thought.text: Endpoint saldo butuh header lain. Saya cek cara yang benar lewat `/api/v1/models` (yang tadi 200) dan cari endpoint saldo di bundle.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && K=$(head -4 nm_api_keys.txt | tail -1 | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}'); echo "key: ${K:0:24}"; for p in /api/v1/credit-balance /api/credit-balance /api/v1/me /api/v1/usage /api/v1/keys; do printf "%-24s " "$p"; curl -s --max-time 25 "https://nomask.ai$p" -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" -o /tmp/n.json -w "%{http_code} "; head -c 120 /tmp/n.json | tr -d '\n'; echo; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && K=$(head -4 nm_api_keys.txt | tail -1 | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,\"\",$2);print $2}'); echo \"key: ${K:0:24}\"; for p in /api/v1/credit-balance /api/credit-balance /api/v1/me /api/v1/usage /api/v1/keys; do printf \"%-24s \" \"$p\"; curl -s --max-time 25 \"https://nomask.ai$p\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $K\" -o /tmp/n.json -w \"%{http_code} \"; head -c 120 /tmp/n.json | tr -d '\\n'; echo; done", "summary": "Probe nomask balance endpoint variants", "security_risk": "LOW"}
